node.title: ef_fullfield_bridge (the s6 F1 typecheck)
node.statement: Every reduced horizontal component of the extension-fiber incidence variety X with TRIVIAL G-stabilizer, satisfying noncontainment, and not confined to a proper intermediate field, is a genuinely full-field extension fiber to which ext_pole_floor applies. Equivalently (s6_extension_lift.md F1): there is no genuinely-F obstruction of non-pole, non-confined type — the honest typecheck seam where a new ledger column (S9) would otherwise appear. This is the SOLE remaining input to Pro's pole-free cycle exclusion completeness proof; the Galois-descent trichotomy is unconditional.
node.falsifier: a genuinely-F horizontal component (trivial stabilizer, noncontainment, non-tower) that is NOT covered by the extension-pole floor — a new S9 ledger class.
node.notes: Pro follow-up brief issued (same ef thread): the S9 typecheck — prove every trivial-stab noncontainment non-tower horizontal component is a base-list F-valued witness line (linear-pencil lever) or exhibit the S9 obstruction. Closes ef chain -> f1. | Pro round 2 (verified): linearity ALONE does not close it (S9 obstruction exhibited).
